text:
Ivan Petrov: Heads-up — Acme reported intermittent 503s and large tail latency from their Dedicated EU cluster this morning. Request IDs: r-9f1c2a3, r-9f1c2a4, r-9f1c2b0. Happens on /v1/generate (streaming) around 08:12-08:20 UTC. Customer says they see spike to ~1.2s per token and some requests fail with HTTP 503. They want a reproducible curl and the node-level debug bundle for our SRE handoff.

Samira Khan: Thanks Ivan. Can you confirm tenant id and cluster name? Also, any recent deploys or autoscaling events?

Ivan Petrov: Tenant: acme-prod-2, cluster: eu-dedicated-3. No deploys from us in that window per deploy-bot. Autoscaler did a couple of scale-ups at 07:50 UTC but settled.

Julia Park: I'll start collecting the node snapshots and kube logs. Adding steps here so support can ask the customer for the curl repro: please ask them to run the curl below (sanitized token) and paste the request-id header that comes back.

Julia Park: ```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-1.2-large", "input":"test latency repro", "stream":false}'
```

Ivan Petrov: Customer ran it and pasted response headers: 
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-request-id: r-9f1c2a4
content-type: application/json
```
They also sent a small SDK trace showing retries and a 503 after ~800ms.

Maria Soto: On infra side: please run these on eu-dedicated-3 (kubectl context = eu-dedicated-3). Collect pod logs for inference pods and node dmesg. Commands: 

```bash
# collect pod logs for last 30m
kubectl -n dedicated get pods -l app=inference -o name | xargs -I{} kubectl -n dedicated logs {} --since=30m > /tmp/inference-pods.log
# node-level dmesg for GPU errors (requires ssh to node)
ssh core@NODE-12 sudo dmesg -T | egrep -i "NVRM|Xid|GPU" > /tmp/node12-dmesg.log
# nvidia-smi sample
ssh core@NODE-12 "nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,POWER,TEMPERATURE" > /tmp/node12-nvidia.log
```

Samira Khan: If anyone oncall is free, pls run the debug bundle tool so we can handoff a single tarball to the customer. Example command: 

```bash
redwood-debug collect --cluster eu-dedicated-3 --tenant acme-prod-2 --since 2025-03-12T07:50:00Z --out /tmp/acme-prod-2-debug.tgz
```

eng-oncall-bot: Debug bundle task queued. ETA ~90s. Trace: dbg-78451.

Julia Park: Noted potential GPU XID events in node12 dmesg earlier today. If XID codes present, attach node XID snippets and kernel logs. XID tends to correlate with aborted kernels causing transient 503s during heavy batching.

Ivan Petrov: Customer also reported one case where auth failed (401) then recovered; they suspect token rotation. Their logs show initial 401 then 503s. Could be a cascade. I asked them to confirm token refresh timing.

Maria Soto: Also capture kubelet metrics for the node around that window: 
```bash
kubectl --context=eu-dedicated-3 top pod -n dedicated --containers --use-protocol-buffers > /tmp/top-pods.txt
curl -s http://NODE-12:10255/metrics | egrep -i "kubelet|container_cpu|container_memory" > /tmp/node-metrics.txt
```

Samira Khan: I'll coordinate with Support AE on the customer side to get the curl output, SDK trace, and the debug bundle once it's ready. @Julia @Maria please drop the bundle location here when available.

metrics-bot: Upload complete: /var/debug/acme-prod-2/debug-dbg-78451.tgz (size: 23.4MB)

Julia Park: Bundle downloaded. Quick findings: inference pods show bursts of CPU wait and occasional NVML errors at 08:12:15. Packaging notes in /diagnostics/README.txt. Uploading a trimmed logs tarball to the case.

Ivan Petrov: Thanks team. I'll send the bundle and the curl repro instructions to Acme support thread and ask them to re-run the curl with the x-request-id included. Please keep this thread updated if you find XID codes or kernel OOMs. :thumbsup:
